subject.title: fix: keep yielded parent runs deferred until subagents settle

question: Should `deferred` become a permanent public cron, protocol, hook, and plugin SDK status, or should yielded-parent waiting remain internal until an existing terminal outcome is available?
rationale: The patch creates a new persisted external state across protocol, CLI, UI, hooks, and SDK; implementation correctness cannot determine the intended long-term product contract.

options.title: Keep Waiting Internal
options.body: Represent the handoff in internal task and session state, then publish an existing cron terminal outcome after parent reconciliation.

options.title: Approve Public Deferred
options.body: Accept `deferred` as a permanent status after external-client, plugin, fresh-install, and upgrade compatibility proof.

options.title: Split The Contract
options.body: Land the internal lifecycle repair separately and review the public status and SDK expansion in a focused follow-up.

recommendation.title: Keep Waiting Internal
recommendation.body: Represent the handoff in internal task and session state, then publish an existing cron terminal outcome after parent reconciliation.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged isolated-cron completion and announce work makes this the strongest available routing candidate for the cron status decision.
